build_text_classification_pipeline: build a TextClassificationPipeline instance using an adapter_id to load a HuggingFace text classification model
run_text_classification: run text classification on a string input and get a list of label score pairs
create_pipeline_with_adapter: create a TextClassificationPipeline by passing an adapter_id to load the underlying transformers pipeline
test_classification_scores: test the TextClassificationPipeline by calling it with text and verifying all label scores are returned
review_pipeline_call_method: review the TextClassificationPipeline call method that returns all classification scores for input text
